knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A change is made as a new revision, the reason is recorded and the old revision is kept on file.
A briefing record shows the briefing took place. It does not prove a control works, and it does not transfer responsibility.
New equipment changes the hazards on the site, so it triggers a review regardless of the calendar.

practicalCriteria: Completes the document control panel with number, revision, revision date, site address, preparer and approver
Records a briefing with the date, topics, people present and questions
Identifies two review triggers in a simulated change and sets a next review date
Issues a new revision with the reason and withdraws the old revision from the site
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: A register is used at a site where the crew has not been briefed on the current revision
An old revision is overwritten and not kept
